description: This file defines the CandidateMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses a trait to configure the candidate menu screen by overriding the current screen to 'viewCandidates'. It is part of the plugin's menu configuration system.

classes.name: CandidateMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the candidate menu in the recruitment module by overriding the current screen to 'viewCandidates'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewCandidates' using helper trait and returns null.
